name: Term
description: Represents the terms under which a sale is made, typically expressed as days due after goods are received, optionally including an early-payment discount or date-driven due dates.

update.note: Full update; body must include all writable fields plus Id and SyncToken. Omitted writable fields are set to NULL.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User recognizable name for the term. For example, Net 30.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Required for update. Incremented on each modification; older SyncTokens are rejected.

fields.name: DiscountPercent
fields.description: Discount percentage available against an amount if paid within the days specified by DiscountDays.

fields.name: DiscountDays
fields.description: Discount applies if paid within this number of days. Used only when DueDays is specified.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: If true, this entity is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Type of the Sales Term. STANDARD is used if DueDays is not null; DATE_DRIVEN is used if DueDays is null.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. Values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated.

fields.name: DayOfMonthDue
fields.description: Payment must be received by this day of the month. Used only if DueDays is not specified. Required if DueDays not present.

fields.name: DiscountDayOfMonth
fields.description: Discount applies if paid before this day of month. Required if DueDays not present.

fields.name: DueNextMonthDays
fields.description: Payment due next month if issued that many days before the DayOfMonthDue. Required if DueDays not present.

fields.name: DueDays
fields.description: Number of days from delivery of goods or services until the payment is due. Required if DayOfMonthDue not present.
